units.source_text: 当夜源氏宿紫夫人房中。

en.t: That night, Genji stayed in Lady Murasaki's rooms.

units.source_text: 紫夫人却留在三公主处，和她谈话，直到破晓才回房来。

en.t: Lady Murasaki, however, remained with the Third Princess, talking with her, and only returned to her own rooms at daybreak.

units.source_text: 两人睡到日高方始起身。

en.t: The two of them slept until the sun was high before finally rising.

units.source_text: 源氏对紫夫人说：“三公主的琴弹得很好了呢！

en.t: Genji said to Lady Murasaki, "The Third Princess has become very good at playing the koto!

units.source_text: 你看如何？”

en.t: What do you think?"

units.source_text: 紫夫人答道：“以前我在她那里，听她弹过一次，觉得还有可议。

en.t: Lady Murasaki replied, "Once before, when I was with her, I heard her play and felt there was still room for improvement.

units.source_text: 现在确已弹得很好了。

en.t: Now she truly does play very well.

units.source_text: 这样专心一意地教导，怎么会不好呢！”

en.t: With such devoted instruction, how could she fail to improve!"

units.source_text: 源氏说：“的确如此。

en.t: Genji said, "That is certainly true.

units.source_text: 差不多天天把住了手教的。

en.t: I taught her almost every day, guiding her hands myself.

units.source_text: 我真是个热心的老师呢。

en.t: I really have been a devoted teacher.

units.source_text: 这件事非常复杂，又很麻烦，要花许多时间，所以我从来不曾教人。

en.t: This art is extremely intricate and troublesome, and it takes a great deal of time, so I had never taught it to anyone before.

units.source_text: 可是此次朱雀院和皇上都说：‘多少总得把七弦琴教教她。’

en.t: But this time both the Suzaku Retired Emperor and His Majesty said, 'You must at least teach her something of the seven-stringed koto.'

units.source_text: 我听了觉得很抱歉。

en.t: When I heard that, I felt deeply sorry.

units.source_text: 我想：此事虽然麻烦，但他们把三公主托付我保护，这一点事情我总得效劳。

en.t: I thought, although this is troublesome, they have entrusted the Third Princess to my care, so I ought at least to do this much for her.

units.source_text: 因此便发心教她。”

en.t: And so I resolved to teach her."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“从前你年纪还小，我抚育你的时候，我公务烦忙，少有空闲，不能从容不迫、专心一志地教导你。

en.t: He went on, "In the old days, when you were still young and I was raising you, I was so busy with official duties and had so little leisure that I could not teach you calmly and with single-minded attention.

units.source_text: 近几年来，不知怎的又是人事栗六，蹉跎岁月。

en.t: In recent years, somehow, worldly affairs have been unsettled again, and the months and years have slipped away in vain.

units.source_text: 我不曾好好教你，而你昨夜弹得非常出色，使我面目增光。

en.t: I never taught you properly, yet last night you played so splendidly that you brought me great honor.

units.source_text: 那时夕雾倾耳而听，惊叹不已。

en.t: At the time, Yugiri listened intently and could not stop marveling.

units.source_text: 我真是如意称心，欢喜无量啊！”

en.t: I was truly satisfied in every way, and my joy was boundless!"
